item.title: All five street lights not working, 19th November
item.description:
None of the street lights are working in Everilda Street so it is completely dark and dangerous from dusk to dawn. I've fallen once already, as has my daughter, who has reduced mobility. Islington Council is responsible for the up-keep of theses lights: Everilda Street is an essential access way for disabled residents. It's been months and still not fixed, now it's dark from around 4pm, this is urgent.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 4, Everilda Street, Barnsbury, Greater London
